title: あなたと私をつなげるライブ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we brood over lyrics for the Grand Concert song, someone floats the idea of having a call-and-response section.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, Light Hello suddenly realizes why the runners who first created the Grand Concert chose song as a medium.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans will never be able to run with their favorite Umamusume, but nothing's stopping them from singing together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seen in this light, the Grand Concert takes on a new meaning—bringing runners and fans closer together. With renewed motivation, we get back to work!
